favourite.heading: Why Iowa State can pull away
bullets: Iowa State is the better football team by 19.1 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+19.1 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 7.6 points to Iowa State (+7.6 pts).
Playing at Iowa State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Iowa State by 1.5 points: ball control vs front disruption (+1.5 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Bowling Green can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 +9.3 to p90 +53.3 for Iowa State, so a projection of +32.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 8.8 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
